sections.heading: Headline — the AI control function is FAITHFUL where it can be measured

fields.label: U-9183 CLOSES
fields.value: The 2-8x curvature gap was a POSITION artefact. Position-matched (same car, same ai_spline_idx, within R = 0.12), median |dcurv| is 0.0197 / 0.0131 / 0.0296 deg on n = 105 / 68 / 104, against a pre-registered band of median <=2 and p90 <=10. FUN_00443440's look-ahead is the LITERAL 10.0f at 0x004162a1 — it does not scale with speed.

fields.label: ...and a second artefact on top
fields.value: The FULL-window curv medians are 94.14 / 11.40 / 38.28 (original) vs 52.04 / 52.81 / 50.08 (port) — on car 1 the ORIGINAL is higher. The 2-8x came from the mode==0 subset, which on the original selects its low-curvature calls.

fields.label: U-9182 ANSWERED
fields.value: c0 comes from ONE branch, MAG at 0x00416697. Car 1 window split: MAG 72 vs 24, MAGHI 62 vs 171, DEAD 54 vs 22, CTR1 32 vs 3, FF30 0 vs 0, CTRHI 0 vs 0. Everything but MAG contributes only 0, so c0_distinct = 1 + |MAG set| = 13 (orig) vs 6 (port).

fields.label: The c0 arithmetic is bit-faithful
fields.value: Recomputing c0 = trunc(min(255, err*speed*0.0030034 * (curv*0.05 if mode==0 and curv>20))) reproduces the logged byte 586/586 on the port and 148/151 on the original (the 3 misses are +1 at the truncation boundary). Do NOT port the magnitude path.

fields.value: KA-A1 4,088,708 / 0 violations (orig) and 1,596 / 0 (port); KA-A2 median 0.0000 and 0.0313; KA-B1 2505/2505 and 26/26, zero violations.

sections.heading: What is LEFT of criterion (b) — U-9185

fields.label: A sub-degree residual across a HARD split
fields.value: At matched position the median |d signed err| is only 0.945 / 1.296 / 0.466 deg. But the LO/HI band split is a discontinuity at err = 0/360 and |err| is a 1-2 deg oscillation about it, so a 1.15 deg bias (port median -0.128 vs orig +1.024) flips the band on 43% / 24% / 13% of matched calls and re-routes the steer byte between ctrl[0] and ctrl[1].

fields.label: Not just position or speed
fields.value: On car 1 the occupancy shift persists at MATCHED SPEED (2606.0 vs 2606.8): port LO 49 / HI 56 against orig LO 92 / HI 13.

fields.label: Where the residual comes from
fields.value: Decomposed: target direction 0.28 / 0.48 / 0.45 deg, body heading 0.98 / 0.91 / 0.65 deg. The heading is a vehicle-physics output, reaching the AI as (cos(a.yaw), sin(a.yaw)) at TrackRenderer.cpp:3729 with a.yaw round-tripped through VehiclePhysics_StepCar — NOT from rec+0x9d4/+0x9dc as AiStandalone.cpp:939 claims.

fields.label: The port-only scaffold
fields.value: VehiclePhysicsRun.cpp:703-707 gives every slot != 0 — i.e. exactly the cars (b) scores — a start boost (+0xbf8=1, +0xbf4=1300), guarded by MASHED_NO_START_BOOST. Port window speed 3421.7 / 3346.2 / 3495.9 vs the original's 2419.5 / 2397.0 / 2617.6 (+41 / +40 / +34%).

sections.heading: Next — and it is NOT a port

fields.label: 1. Start-boost A/B
fields.value: One environment variable, no code change: re-capture with MASHED_NO_START_BOOST=1 and re-score BOTH (b) and (e). (e) passes today WITH the boost, so the seed cannot be removed on (b)'s evidence alone — an (e) regression is a trade-off for the user, not a fix. Pre-register the rule first.

fields.label: 2. Only if that fails
fields.value: The AI cars' body heading — two separable candidates: the physics' own io.yaw (a D2 surface measured through the AI) and the scalar reconstruction standing in for the record's forward basis row (a port-only bridge, cheaper to test).

fields.label: RULED OUT
fields.value: FUN_00414c30 + producer chain. Its effect on (b) is through ai_mode, already refuted as sufficient by the modes-3/7 arms, and curv and c0's arithmetic are now proved faithful — that chain cannot reach what is left. SelectSpline is also not a lead: the original's spline arg equals 0x801aa0 + ai_spline_idx*0x204 on 5463 of 5463 rows.

fields.label: A QUESTION FOR THE USER
fields.value: (b)'s c0_distinct / c1_distinct / steer_distinct count which side of a hard discontinuity a 1-2 deg oscillation lands on, so a faithful port can fail them. Whether to re-specify (b) on a band-invariant statistic is a ROADMAP decision. No band was moved.
